note: Register of the places that hold or receive personal information, as data (P-39.1 arts. 17 and 18.3). A region is written only where the deployment spec (deploy/digitalocean/app.yaml) proves it; otherwise « to-confirm » (krizaka/.github#285, which waits on the founder). Canadian hosting for production is planned, not claimed. Read by apps/web/lib/transfers.test.ts, which fails when the spec adds a store, a region or a configuration context this file does not list.

contextsNotDeployed.MAIL_: mail delivery is off in the deployment (MAIL_PROVIDER=none keeps every mail pending); when it is turned on, add the provider to `processors` first
contextsNotDeployed.PAYMENTS_: the subscription processor is configured outside the spec; add it to `processors` before it is set in the spec
contextsNotDeployed.AI_: no model runs in the deployment; the translation call to Orazaka is off until the Studio is wired

stores.what: the application (sessions, the BFF, the files in transit)
accounts, shops, clients, appointments, invoices, the tax ledger, consents, visit reports (including their photos)
a shop's photos and the files of a client's request

processors.name: DigitalOcean
processors.receives: everything the application and the database hold
processors.region: proven for the two stores above only; backups and the managed database's replicas: to-confirm
processors.dpa: provider's data processing terms, to collect (krizaka/.github#285)

processors.name: Bunny
processors.receives: the photos and files an owner or a client adds; the CDN edge serves them worldwide
processors.region: storage zone: New York; CDN edge locations: to-confirm
processors.dpa: provider's data processing terms, to collect (krizaka/.github#285)

processors.name: Mailgun
processors.receives: the recipient's address and the body of a walk report or an invoice mail
processors.dpa: provider's data processing terms, to collect (krizaka/.github#285)

processors.name: Stripe
processors.receives: the subscriber's e-mail and payment details, on the processor's hosted page; never a shop client's data
processors.dpa: provider's data processing terms, to collect (krizaka/.github#285)

processors.name: Orazaka (Krizaka's engine)
processors.receives: the page's own texts and a glossary (shop name, service names, street address); never anything about a client
processors.region: to-confirm (its GPU hosting is RunPod, in the supplier register)
processors.dpa: to write with the engine's hosting provider
